fact: FAO's GIEWS country brief with reference date 30 September 2026 states that, as indicated by remote sensing imagery (VHI map), 2026 rainfall deficits significantly affected vegetation in Eritrean cropping areas including Gash Barka, and it cites FAO/GIEWS Earth Observation for Crop Monitoring as a source.
title: GIEWS Country Brief: The State of Eritrea
